sentences.en: Adam was furious with me when I broke his watch.
sentences.zh: 亚当看到我把他的手表弄坏了，气得要命。

sentences.en: Our latest results are the fruit of his furious efforts.
sentences.zh: 我们最新的成果是他拼命努力的结果。

sentences.en: He is furious at what they have done to him.
sentences.zh: 他得知他们对他做了些什么后非常愤怒。

senses.zh: 狂怒的，暴怒的；狂暴的，猛烈的；喧闹的，热烈兴奋的
